source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Members (June 2022)
source.content:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members! 

Applicants must meet the following requirements for applying:

* Fluency in English.
* Have been involved in at least five competitions as an organizer or key staff member.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion [10.2021.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf). 

<!-- break -->

The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:

* Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.
* Handling change requests to competitions.
* Debating and voting with the rest of the Team.

The expected qualities of applicants include:

* Proactive personality, sense of detail, and solution-oriented thinking.
* Ability to check messages from the team several times a day and flexibility in handling urgent requests.
* Good familiarity with the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf).
* Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Regulations and WCA Policies.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* A brief personal introduction.
* A concrete overview on how you fulfil the requirements, and the expected qualities.
* (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until June 21st 2022 23:59 UTC to Wilson Alvis (walvis@worldcubeassociation.org) and Daniel Vædele Egdal (degdal@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示团队成员招募（2022 年 6 月）
translation.content:
WCA 比赛公示团队（WCAT）正在招募新成员！

申请者须符合以下要求：

* 能流利使用英语。
* 曾以组织者或核心工作人员的身份参与至少五场比赛。

WCAT 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 动议 [10.2021.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

WCAT 成员的日常工作包括：

* 审核提交的比赛申请，确保信息准确无误后公示比赛。
* 处理比赛信息变更申请。
* 与团队其他成员讨论并投票。

我们希望申请者具备以下条件：

* 积极主动、注重细节，善于思考解决办法。
* 每天能多次查看团队消息，并灵活处理紧急请求。
* 熟悉 [WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)。
* 对 WCA 竞赛规则及各项政策有足够了解。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 具体说明自己如何符合上述要求和期望。
* （可选）其他自认为与本职务有关、但上述未列出的能力和资历。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2022 年 6 月 21 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料发送给 Wilson Alvis（walvis@worldcubeassociation.org）及 Daniel Vædele Egdal（degdal@worldcubeassociation.org）。
